payload.note: Finding 2 (terminal escape injection) fixed. Fix: new src/llm/sanitize.ts sanitizeVendorText strips C0 (keeping newline and tab), folds and strips C1 introducers, and removes ESC-initiated sequences wholesale (CSI, OSC to BEL or ST, DCS/SOS/PM/APC to ST, two-char escapes, unterminated ones to end of string). Applied at src/gm/text.ts tidyText — the single boundary every model-sourced string crosses (scenario fields, narration lines, Q&A answer, plus the player's own question on its way into a prompt); chosen over the HTTP layer because scenario and narration arrive as JSON, so escapes travel JSON-escaped and only become real control characters after the second decode, downstream of the transport. text.ts also absorbs the previously duplicated tidy/clamp/unfence helpers. The vendor-echoed model id (a ledger row, not prose, not JSON-decoded) is sanitized in parseCompletion where it enters. Engine text untouched. Tests: tests/llm/sanitize.test.ts (13 cases, payloads built from String.fromCharCode) and a hostile-vendor case in tests/ui/loop.test.ts driving the real loop over the real fake vendor with laced scenario, narration, Q&A and model id — the captured transcript has zero control characters, no OSC payload, and keeps every legible word. That test was red before the fix with 19 control characters on screen. Commit a47d497.
